name: Noida International Airport, Jewar
description: Airport runway and terminal construction replacing agricultural fields; public environmental clearance on record. Registered platform boundary is approximate.

replay.note: Compares March 2021 with March 2025, across years of construction. The registered zone outline is approximate, and nearby fields also change with crops.

name: Navi Mumbai International Airport, Ulwe
description: Runway and terminal built on an already graded airport platform between 2021 and 2025. Public EC/CRZ records exist; the registered platform outline is illustrative.

sources.title: NMIA Environmental & CRZ compliance report, April–September 2025

replay.note: Compares January 2021 with January 2025. This shows building on prepared land, not the earlier hill removal or mangrove reclamation. The registered zone outline is approximate.

name: Parsa East Kete Basan mine, Hasdeo Arand
description: Open-cast mine with visible bench advance and changing bare ground. Phase-II authorisation is documented; clearance and environmental concerns have been contested. Approximate mine footprint only.

sources.title: Supreme Court order, CA 4395/2014, 16 October 2023 (Indian Kanoon transcript)
NGT e-Journal 2025, pp.32–36, OA 59/2024 and connected matters

replay.note: Compares February 2021 with March 2025. The registered outline is approximate and smaller than the full lease, and the clearance has been contested in court.

name: Rawa–Nangal border ridge quarries
description: Quarrying on the Rawa–Nangal border ridge. Public NGT filings discuss reported unauthorised workings and nearby Rajasthan leases. No authorisation on record in this system's registry; this is not evidence that every quarry lacks a permit.

sources.title: Rajasthan respondent reply in NGT OA 06/2025, incident-site coordinates
Haryana respondent reply in NGT OA 06/2025

replay.note: Compares March 2021 with March 2025. The area crosses a state boundary and permits exist nearby, so imagery alone cannot tie an individual cut to a state or lease.

name: Mundakkai–Chooralmala debris-flow corridor, Wayanad
description: Visible widening and deposition along the 30 July 2024 debris-flow corridor. The monitored area includes the source area and part of the runout, not the entire approximately 8 km path.

sources.title: Yunus et al., Documenting the Wayanad landslide

replay.note: Compares 5 February and 16 December 2024. Cloud delayed the later image by months after the 30 July 2024 debris flow. The area covers part of the roughly 8 km runout.

name: Kanha forest–meadow seasonal reference
description: Forest–meadow mosaic showing dry-season canopy browning and post-monsoon greening. Same-season April 2023 and April 2024 imagery retain the same wooded margins; intended no-alert reference.

sources.title: Madhya Pradesh Tourism: Kanha National Park, seasonal vegetation guidance

replay.note: Compares November 2023 with April 2024, using an April 2023 reference, to separate dry-season browning from lasting change.

name: Yamuna floodplain near Shastri Park, Delhi
description: Yamuna flooding during the documented July 2023 event; water spread is visible in clear portions of a partly cloudy 13 July scene. Cloud-limited replay: this site allows tile cloud up to 85 percent to reach that scene.

sources.title: NRSC Delhi flood report, 13 July 2023, Ref.2023/FL/DL/04

replay.note: Compares 8 June and 13 July 2023, around the documented 12-13 July flood. Cloud covers part of the later image, so about 80% of the area could be analysed.
